description:
Deterministic forensic-accounting scores for a single ticker: partial Beneish M-Score, Sloan accruals, and a solvency snapshot. Returns a red-flag narrative ranked by severity, with citations to source filings. Used by the `forensic_earnings_brief` SOP.

Note: full Beneish needs AR / current assets / PPE / SGA / current liabilities, which aren't in our fundamentals model. We compute the recoverable subset (SGI + TATA + LVGI) and flag `partial=true`. For a bank the M-Score, its components and Sloan accruals are null (`null_reasons`: NOT_MEANINGFUL_FOR_SECTOR); the solvency snapshot is still served, its debt ratios with a `sector_notes` sentence (borrowings only, deposits excluded). Plan: Benchmark and above.

ticker.description: Stock ticker symbol of the company to audit, e.g. AAPL, MSFT, BRK.B.

name: forensic_audit

_meta.description: Response metadata (provenance, point-in-time flag, freshness, request id and warnings). Every field is documented once in the agent contract (agent_contract.meta in the server's manifest.json).

metrics_display.description: Each figure in `result` rendered for prose, keyed by its path ('sloan_accruals', 'solvency.roa', 'm_score_components.sgi'). QUOTE THESE VERBATIM instead of the raw numbers.

null_reasons.description: Present for a company whose sector the accrual scores do not fit (a bank): `m_score`, `m_score_components` and `sloan_accruals` are null with reason NOT_MEANINGFUL_FOR_SECTOR. Do not compute them yourself.

sector_notes.description: Present for a bank: keyed by path ('solvency.debt_to_equity', 'solvency.debt_to_assets'), the sentence to state beside the figure (borrowings only, deposits excluded).

title: Forensic Audit (Beneish + Sloan + Solvency)
